title: Stellar Echoes
description: Stellar Echoes is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 with a cosmic/magic theme. It adds 3 items (Celestial Dust, Star Fragment, Starweave Wand), 3 blocks (Starfall Crystal Ore, Astral Lantern, Void Blossom), and generates a new ore underground.
body:
Stellar Echoes
  
  Stellar Echoes is a celestial magic mod for Minecraft 1.21+ (Fabric) that weaves starlight into the world around you.
  Explore underground caves for rare crystal ore, craft powerful magical tools, and illuminate your world with astral
  light.

  ---
  ✦ What's Added
  
  New Ores & Resources

  - Starfall Crystal Ore — A rare ore that spawns deep in the Overworld. Mine it to harvest crystals and earn bonus XP
  (3–7 per ore). Requires a pickaxe to mine.
  - Celestial Dust — A shimmering crafting material collected from Starfall Crystals.
  - Star Fragment — A refined material at the heart of Stellar Echoes' crafting progression.

  Magical Items

  - Starweave Wand — The centerpiece of this mod. Right-click to pulse a wave of starlight in an 8-block radius,
  applying the Glowing effect to all nearby creatures for 15 seconds — making invisible mobs visible and hidden threats
  impossible to miss. Bursts of End Rod particles light up the air around you when activated. The wand has 128 charges
  and a short cooldown between uses.

  Decorative Blocks

  - Astral Lantern — A bright, glowing decorative light source that emits full-brightness light. Perfect for
  celestial-themed builds.
  - Void Blossom — A mysterious purple flower found growing in the world, adding a touch of cosmic beauty to any
  landscape.

  ---
  ✦ Why Download It?

  Stellar Echoes is perfect if you want:
  - A lightweight magic mod without overwhelming complexity
  - A practical utility tool (the Starweave Wand is genuinely useful for finding mobs in caves and the dark)
  - Themed decorative blocks for celestial or space-inspired builds
  - A new ore to add variety to underground exploration
